title: Design review from seeded dashboard markup
objective: Measure whether the design-review craftbook scopes heuristics and produces prioritized, concrete UX/visual findings.
prompt: In the `Design Review Eval` project, read `source/dashboard.html` and write `tasks/eval/design-review.md`. Review the Orders dashboard for visual hierarchy, spacing/alignment, type scale, contrast, consistency, affordance/feedback, empty/loading/error/success states, and primary-task friction. Every finding needs screen/element, impact, severity, and a concrete fix with values.
